item.title: UACD host three speakers running for public office, discuss platforms from each campaign
item.description: The UA College Democrats hosted Democratic candidates Dakarai Larriett, Ashleigh Dunham and Amanda Pusczek on Tuesday to discuss their campaign platforms, the state of Alabama and students’ concerns about political issues. item.description: The University announced the launch of the COMPASS Brain Health Initiative in partnership with the Alabama Department of Rehabilitation Services on Tuesday. item.description: To the sound of blaring horns and thumping bass, University of Alabama doctoral alum and instructor of music Warren Ertle strikes up his vintage jazz band every Tuesday evening, part of an ongoing musical residency at The Sanctuary on 25th.
